params.body:
The pipeline is served under `/api/pipeline/` by nginx, which strips that prefix before the server checks the request. `systemRead()` signed the public path (`/api/pipeline/mix`) while the pipeline verified `/mix`, so every read was refused with "the request's signature does not hold under #agent-workbench-shed", although the mandate itself was accepted.

The signature now covers the path as the system sees it: the route passed in, normalised the way the server parses it. The system cannot know a proxy's prefix; the caller can.

Tried against production with the admitted 30-day read: `observatory.mjs mix source 7` answers (23,431 in, 6,223 kept, 86 cited over 7 days).
